info.title: Relisoft HR API
info.description:
Relisoft HR Portal API.

Demo logins (password: `password`): `preeti`, `rakesh`, `aradhana`.

1. Call `POST /api/auth/login` with `{ "username": "preeti", "password": "password" }`.
2. Copy the `token` from the response.
3. Click **Authorize** and paste the token (the `Bearer ` prefix is added automatically).

Bearer.description: Paste the JWT token obtained from `POST /api/auth/login`.
